principles.binding: EXECUTE must reference a valid prior DECIDE request_id. Capability must have been offered by that DECIDE response.
principles.validation: Backend validates capability and scope against the authoritative capability registry. Unknown fields, invalid canonical IDs, or unsupported dimensions are rejected; they are never interpreted.
principles.result: RESULT contains only certified evidence satisfying the complete effective scope.
principles.context: CONTEXT preserves every RESULT scope dimension except time. Only temporal restrictions may be relaxed. If the capability has no temporal dimension, CONTEXT is null.
principles.computation: Backend owns filtering, joins, counts, comparisons, aggregation and other deterministic operations represented by a capability. ChatGPT must not recompute backend-owned results.
principles.provenance: Returned records carry sufficient evidence/provenance for auditability.
principles.no_data: An empty certified result is returned as NO_DATA; backend does not broaden scope to find something similar.

expected_semantics.result: Only published portfolio records mapped to COLUN.
Only historical published insights mapped to ONLINE_SHOPPING, preserving attribution and historical warning.
